notes: Two branches: «ح» after Muhammad b. Ja'far; the second branch's heads narrate from Ghundar («قال عقبة حدثنا وقال أبو بكر أخبرنا غندر»); the names after them are the shared tail (rule 3)
«أمه» is a relation link (rule 7); Umm Salama is the last link, the Prophet is the end
The text does not say that Muhammad b. Ja'far is Ghundar: the taḥwīl is read as the text writes it, identities not decided
